+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""O2: tinygrad (CPU) vs torch (CPU) for cases that define tfn.
+Tolerances mirror test/backend/test_ops.py helper_test_op: fwd atol=1e-6 rtol=1e-3, grad atol=1e-4 rtol=1e-3."""
+import sys, os, csv, time, signal
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from cases import CASES, inputs_for, weight_for
+from tinygrad import Tensor
+
+ATOL_F, RTOL_F = 1e-6, 1e-3
+ATOL_G, RTOL_G = 1e-4, 1e-3
+TIMEOUT = int(os.environ.get("CASE_TIMEOUT", "60"))
+class CaseTimeout(Exception): pass
+signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, lambda s, f: (_ for _ in ()).throw(CaseTimeout()))
+
+def maxdiff(a, b):
+  if a.shape != b.shape: return float("inf")
+  if a.size == 0: return 0.0
+  d = np.abs(a.astype(np.float64) - b.astype(np.float64))
+  return float(np.nanmax(d)) if not np.all(np.isnan(d)) else 0.0
+
+csv_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "sweep_log.csv")
+w = csv.writer(open(csv_path, "a", newline="", buffering=1))
+sel = [c for c in CASES if c.tfn is not None]
+npass = 0
+for case in sel:
+  t0 = time.time(); status, note, wf, wg = "PASS", "", 0.0, 0.0
+  try:
+    signal.alarm(TIMEOUT)
+    ins = inputs_for(case)
+    # tinygrad side
+    ts = [Tensor(a, device="CPU") for a in ins]
+    out = case.fn(*ts)
+    fwd = out.numpy()
+    wnp = weight_for(case, fwd.shape)
+    gs = [g.numpy() for g in (out * Tensor(wnp, device="CPU")).sum().gradient(*ts)] if case.grad else None
+    # torch side
+    tts = [torch.from_numpy(a.copy()).requires_grad_(case.grad) for a in ins]
+    tout = case.tfn(*tts)
+    tfwd = tout.detach().numpy()
+    tgs = None
+    if case.grad:
+      (tout * torch.from_numpy(wnp)).sum().backward()
+      tgs = [t.grad.numpy() for t in tts]
+    signal.alarm(0)
+    wf = maxdiff(fwd, tfwd)
+    if fwd.shape != tfwd.shape: status, note = "SHAPE_MISMATCH", f"{fwd.shape} vs {tfwd.shape}"
+    elif np.isnan(fwd).sum() != np.isnan(tfwd).sum(): status = "NAN_PATTERN_FWD"
+    elif not np.allclose(fwd, tfwd, atol=ATOL_F, rtol=RTOL_F, equal_nan=True): status = "FWD_MISMATCH"
+    if status == "PASS" and gs is not None:
+      for gi, tgi in zip(gs, tgs):
+        wg = max(wg, maxdiff(gi, tgi))
+        if not np.allclose(gi, tgi, atol=ATOL_G, rtol=RTOL_G, equal_nan=True): status = "GRAD_MISMATCH"; break
+  except CaseTimeout:
+    signal.alarm(0); status, note = "TIMEOUT", f">{TIMEOUT}s"
+  except Exception as e:
+    signal.alarm(0); status, note = "ERROR", f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:160]}"
+  secs = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
+  w.writerow([int(t0), "O2-torch", case.target, case.id, status, f"{wf:.3e}", f"{wg:.3e}", secs, note])
+  npass += status == "PASS"
+  print(f"{case.id:32s} {status:16s} fwd={wf:.2e} grad={wg:.2e} {note[:70]}")
+print(f"\nO2 done: {npass} pass / {len(sel)} cases")
